notes: A lighter start: drop one file into any chat, see the sample hub first, a 15-minute interview, and your helpers ask the rest when it matters.

changes.title: Setup starts in a plain chat: drop in the OS file and type start, no Project to make first
See it first: the setup chat opens with the sample hub before any questions
The interview is about 15 minutes: 14 questions, only what your team needs to feel like yours on day one
Helpers ask the rest just in time (Still to learn): a few questions when the work needs them, never a second interview
Along the way, the odd glimpse of what your team will do with what you've just said: reassuring, never a pitch
